verdict.summary: Round 3 remains correct and complete. The workflow runs the sparq-vectors suite on a real GitHub-hosted aarch64 runner, fails closed unless the host is aarch64 with ASIMD, enables the feature that compiles and reaches the SIMD dispatcher, and verifies that the SIMD tests are present in nextest's inventory before execution. The path filters, permissions, concurrency, pinned actions, timeout, feature scope, and cache configuration remain coherent. The unsafe-register edits accurately describe architecture-specific numeric execution evidence without overclaiming memory-safety proof. No correctness, soundness, test-validity, injection, or security defect was found. Because round 2 also had no findings, progress is stagnant under the required scale.
